runtime_dependencies.reason: Sudocode 0.2.0 depends on better-sqlite3 11.x, whose native addon is not admitted on Node 24.

observations.reason: Sudocode's better-sqlite3 11.x process aborts during native cleanup. Use the admitted Node 22 runtime until the tracker publishes a compatible dependency.

The adapter resolves the generated supertest/types import with Vitest's bundler resolution, but the official scaffold still fails npm audit on high-severity transitive vulnerabilities from @nestjs/mau. See VALIDATION.md.
